optional_reading.name: Addy Osmani - LLM Coding Workflow
optional_reading.description: Planning-first AI coding workflow patterns and scope-management heuristics

optional_reading.name: Spec-Driven Development: The Spec Is the New Code (@juliandeangeIis)
optional_reading.description: Guide on spec-driven development (SDD) for AI coding agents — separating functional from technical specs before execution. Key insight: the biggest bottleneck isn't the model, it's the human giving instructions; separating functional from technical specs reduces LLM uncertainty

optional_reading.name: The Machine that Builds the Machine — Symphony (@daniel_mac8)
optional_reading.description: Real-world orchestration workflow: Symphony uses 300-line Jinja2 playbook templates per issue type, polling Linear for work, spawning Codex agents in isolated workspaces, and completing full ticket-to-PR lifecycle. Demonstrates issue-driven development at scale

optional_reading.name: Task Master AI
optional_reading.description: Feed a PRD to get structured tasks with dependencies; Claude executes them. Reference for automated planning-to-execution workflows and PRD-driven task decomposition

optional_reading.name: Using Codex Goals Effectively — Chris Hayduk (OpenAI)
optional_reading.description: First-party guidance on multi-day Codex /goal runs: source for the 3-file journaling pattern (PLAN.md / EXPERIMENTS.md / EXPERIMENT_NOTES.md) that separates curated history from append-only scratchpad. Cited in Long-Horizon Agent Journaling section.

optional_reading.name: Using Claude Code: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of HTML — Thariq (Anthropic)
optional_reading.description: First-party Claude Code team guidance on HTML as output format for human-facing plans and specs. Cited in Output Format for Plan Documents: 100-line read-through threshold, 2-4x generation cost, export-button closure pattern, version-control diff tradeoffs.

optional_reading.name: You Need More Than a Ralph Loop — Jarrod Watts
optional_reading.description: Critique of bare ralph/goal-mode loops with three failure modes: ambiguity compounds, single-context-window saturation, cross-context memory gaps. Source for the Watts 4-file journaling pattern (GOAL.md / STANDARDS.md / IMPLEMENT.md / PROGRESS.md) and the pre-loop interview phase. Companion github skill: https://github.com/jarrodwatts/long-running-agent-skill

optional_reading.name: GitHub Spec Kit
optional_reading.description: Open-source spec-driven development toolkit from GitHub. Announced 2025-09-02; star count grows fast (≈92k early May 2026, ≈111k mid-June 2026) — check star-history.com/github/spec-kit for the current figure rather than repeating a fixed number. Ships Spec→Plan→Tasks→Implement pipeline, 30+ agent integrations (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Kiro, Windsurf), EARS notation support. Docs: https://github.github.com/spec-kit/

optional_reading.name: Kiro — AWS Spec-Driven AI IDE
optional_reading.description: AWS spec-driven AI IDE launched mid-2025, powered by Claude via Amazon Bedrock. Enforces requirements.md (EARS format) → design.md → tasks.md → implementation pipeline. Adds agent hooks (event-driven background automations), MCP support, steering rules. Pricing moved to a multi-tier credit model: Free (50 credits/month), Pro ($20/month), plus Pro+/Pro Max/Power tiers — verify current tiers at kiro.dev/pricing since this has already changed once. Verified 2026-07.

optional_reading.name: BMAD-METHOD
optional_reading.description: Open-source agentic spec-driven framework. Orchestrates 12+ AI agents (Analyst, PM, Architect, Scrum Master, Developer, QA), each consuming specs produced by the previous stage. Reference for multi-agent spec pipeline design.

optional_reading.name: Claude Code Plan Mode / Ultraplan Docs
optional_reading.description: Plan mode is read-only (no writes, no side effects). Enter via /plan (Jan 2026), Shift+Tab twice, or --permission-mode plan. Ultraplan (research preview, gated to paid plans) offloads planning to a cloud session running multiple agents in parallel — it is a cloud-parallel mode, not a slower-but-deeper local mode. Plan mode's benefit is avoiding trial-and-error rework tokens; do not quote a specific percentage figure without checking it against this current doc first.

optional_reading.name: Kiro Introducing Blog Post
optional_reading.description: Official Kiro launch post. Confirms spec-first pipeline, EARS-formatted requirements.md, agent hooks, MCP support. Pricing has since moved to a multi-tier credit model (see kiro.dev/pricing) — this post reflects launch-time pricing only. Verified 2026-07.

optional_reading.name: Addy Osmani agent-skills — interview-me
optional_reading.description: MIT-licensed skill defining the one-question-at-a-time-with-attached-guess interview mechanic and the falsifiable 'predict the next three reactions' stop test, used in Pre-loop setup phase. Commit 7676817. Extracted 2026-08-09.
